headline: Indian markets extend rally to 9-month highs driven by record FII buying and deal activity

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Record FII buying extended the Indian stock market rally to 9-month highs.
Major corporate deal announcements and growth targets boosted stock-specific momentum.
Fed rate hike signals and global AI selloffs created occasional range-bound pressures.
Positive undertone remains intact despite mixed opening cues from global markets.
whatHappening: Tata Steel announced a ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes for two units.
Shree Cement set targets to cross 100 MT capacity in 3-4 years with 9-10% growth.
PNB MD clarified ECL provision requirement of ₹5,000 crore will not impact profitability.
Federation of Indian Pilots wrote to Civil Aviation Minister regarding the SpiceJet crisis.
summary:
Indian stock markets extended their four-week rally to nine-month highs on strong record FII inflows.
Tata Steel struck a major ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes, while Shree Cement mapped aggressive capacity expansion.
Banking and airline stocks remain in focus following regulatory, provisioning, and operational developments.
